content_sections.heading: PESB Notification PDF 2026

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Engineering Graduate from a recognized University/ Institute. Applicants holding MBA/PGDM will have an added advantage. Experience: At least five years experience during the last ten years in construction or technical operation or maintenance of Power Plants in an organization of repute with establishments at multiple locations having pan India presence Age limit: Minimum 45 years (on the date of occurrence of vacancy (DOV)) Other conditions: SPSE, private company, JV or federation must have average annual turnover of Rs. 10,000 crore or more CPSE applicants need one year (internal) or two years (others) in an eligible scale as on date of vacancy Central Government Group A officers must hold a Joint Secretary level or equivalent post on substantive basis Armed Forces applicants must hold a post of the level of Major General or equivalent Desirable: MBA/PGDM will have an added advantage Preference to candidates from listed companies in case of private company

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for PESB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons employed in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity Officers drawing eligible pay scale merely on NFU/NBR basis without holding substantive post Applicants who do not give the undertaking to join if selected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Five years from date of joining or up to superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier Central Government officers considered only on immediate absorption basis Unwillingness to join after interview or offer leads to debarment for two years from Board level posts in CPSEs

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Annual Reports of three preceding financial years of current organisation (private/JV/federation applicants; URL or copies) Documentary proof that the company is listed (private company applicants) Evidence of working at Board level or immediately below Board level (private/JV/federation applicants) Self-attested copies of documents in support of age and qualifications (private/JV/federation applicants) Relevant jobs handled in the past with details (private/JV/federation applicants) Vigilance profile in 13 points proforma prescribed by CVC, attached by forwarding authority

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PESB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill up the Application Form online only against this Job Description on the PESB website https://pesb.gov.in/. Give the undertaking in the application that you will join the post if selected. Nodal officer/ competent authority forwards the application online through the proper channel as per para V(1). Applicants from private companies apply directly to PESB. Applicant deadline 03:00 PM on 14.12.2026; forwarding deadline 05:00 PM on 23.12.2026. Applications in physical form or through e-mail are rejected.
